purpose: Correct first HUD pass to match owner-selected C2 artwork

prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / production raster UI asset atlas. Reference image 1 is the OWNER-SELECTED C2 Veil Sigils design for Battle of Gods. Reproduce its illustrated game-interface quality, not a minimalist wireframe. Generate FOUR complete isolated production assets on genuinely transparent background, in EXACTLY a 2-by-2 grid of equal square cells. Each object stays inside its own quadrant with abundant transparent spacing. No labels or text anywhere.
TOP LEFT: the reference's complete octagonal King portrait badge, tousled dark brown hair, warm small face, serious eyes, red scarf and slate armored shoulders; clear silver/black beveled frame with tiny cold-cyan crystal corner accents. NO level tag. Match the reference's handsome compact portrait, not a bulky face or an afro. Finely illustrated pixel-RPG UI shading; preserve neck, shoulders and hair.
TOP RIGHT: a blank long thin HP FRAME, about 7:1 aspect ratio. Match reference top-left HP rail: black/navy inset, substantial double-layer silver/black bevel, subtly chamfered ends and tiny cold-cyan corner gems. Center is a clean uniformly dark EMPTY rectangular well. NO red fill, no HP words, no digits. Native game code will add the dynamic red fill inside the well. A refined dark steel frame, not a plain outline.
BOTTOM LEFT: one empty long thin EQUIPPED-WEAPON readout FRAME, about 7:1 aspect ratio, same illustrated obsidian/pewter design with faint violet edge accent. Clean dark empty well for a weapon icon and game text. No mastery words, no progress gauge and no sample values.
BOTTOM RIGHT: one small wide rectangular STAT CHIP FRAME, about 3:1 aspect ratio, dark well, clean stepped pewter border and restrained cool corner facets. Blank inside, no icon and no text.
The assets must match image 1's rich beveled steel, strong dark outlines and restrained blue/violet crystals. Ornamental but crisp and compact at game scale. Use deliberate pixel clusters and substantial readable shapes; not hairline dotted circuits, not flat vector rectangles, no gold, no fog, no diffuse glow. Maintain clear opaque dark wells, fully transparent outside each complete silhouette. No screenshot or landscape. Output exactly the four reusable UI assets; all game text/numbers are added separately.

Use case: ui-mockup / production raster UI asset atlas. Reference image1 is the OWNER-SELECTED C2 Veil Sigils HUD for Battle of Gods. Generate exactly EIGHT isolated complete assets on genuinely transparent background, in a precise 4-column by 2-row grid of equal square cells, every asset wholly inside its cell with ample transparent padding. No text or numbers at all. Match reference's substantial dark outlines, illustrated pixel-RPG steel bevels and readable cyan/violet crystals; preserve the high quality of the reference rather than minimalist generic UI.
TOP ROW from left to right:
1. One blank ROUND SKILL MEDALLION: charcoal/obsidian interior disk, clearly layered black/pewter beveled ring with a few readable cyan rune insets and tiny violet facets. Thick enough to read at40x40 pixels, fully round outer silhouette and a large clean dark center for a separate24px spell glyph. No icon, no key label.
2. One long very slim XP RAIL, about14:1 aspect ratio, reference's thin dark silver rail with a purple diamond/crystal cap at EACH end. Empty dark center, no blue fill, no text. Complete crystals and complete ends visible, no fragments touching the cell edge. Native code adds blue fill and XP digits.
3. The reference's BAG button face: one compact square dark steel frame with cyan corner studs, containing a clearly readable warm brown leather satchel with a small brass clasp. No letters, no key label. This is the complete illustrated button face, not a photo.
4. The reference's SETTINGS button face: matching square dark steel frame with cyan/violet corner studs, containing a readable silver mechanical gear with a dark round center. No words or key label.
BOTTOM ROW from left to right:
5. One RED ATTACK status icon: short diagonal ivory sword silhouette on a rich dark-red small square tile, black/pewter outline.
6. One BLUE DEFENSE status icon: simple ivory/blue shield on rich dark-blue small square tile, black/pewter outline.
7. One GREEN ATTACK-SPEED status icon: bright green upward arrow on a dark-green small square tile, black/pewter outline.
8. One simple isolated silver/ice-blue SWORD family icon, diagonal complete blade, crossguard, dark leather grip and pommel, no square background.
Clear complete silhouettes on transparency. Compact original fantasy RPG interface art faithful to reference. No golden UI rims, no vector placeholders, no realistic materials, no drawn checkerboard, no extra ninth asset. Keep border and crystal detail readable at small native game sizes.

Use case: production fantasy RPG ability icon. Reference image1 is the selected C2 HUD. Create ONLY the separate DODGE glyph from its bottom-right SPACE medallion, on a genuinely transparent background: an ivory/cold-cyan running human silhouette with a bent forward torso, one forward knee and a trailing leg, a single short blue motion streak behind and a little forward-pointing cyan ground swoosh. Match reference's clear illuminated pixel-RPG glyph at24x24 native pixels, deliberate substantial white/cyan clusters, dark-blue defining edges, extremely readable tiny silhouette. No portrait likeness needed; this is a symbolic UI icon. NO medallion/frame/circle/tile, no letters or numbers, no gold or purple, no soft fog. One fully visible isolated glyph, square composition with generous transparent padding, crisp nearest-neighbor pixel look.
